title: Imperial Envoy
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the envoy departed, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—the imperial mark had activated on its own, emitting an eerie fluctuation that did not belong to the mortal world, as if something was watching him through this mark.

text.content:
Above the imperial capital, nine golden rays pierced through the clouds, tearing apart the morning mist. That was the unique cloud-riding technique of the imperial dragon carriage—the entire protective mountain formation of the Tianqing Sect hummed at this moment, as if bowing to some higher authority.

Chen Ji stood behind the crowd, his gaze passing through layers of disciples' shoulders, landing on the slowly descending golden convoy. His expression was calm to the point of being wooden, only his fingertips gently rubbing together within his sleeve—where a fragmented jade piece lay, emanating a faint glow.

That was a fragment of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) Imperial envoy... arrived three days earlier than I anticipated. It seems someone couldn't wait any longer.

text.content:
The convoy halted, and twelve golden-armored warriors descended first, forcibly separating the surrounding crowd. Their aura was profound and deep as an abyss—each one at the late Foundation Building stage, capable of serving as elders in any medium-sized sect, yet here they were merely imperial ceremonial guards.

A middle-aged man in a purple-gold official robe stepped out of the dragon carriage, his gaze sweeping over the crowd like an eagle's, finally pausing on Tianqing Sect Master Ling Yuan for a moment. A faint, imperceptible cold smile curved his lips.

That was the scrutiny of a superior looking down upon an inferior.

dialogue.content: (Purple-robed envoy) By the grace of Heaven, the Emperor's decree—Chen Ji, servant disciple of Tianqing Sect, possesses outstanding virtue and merit, hereby promoted to Crown Prince's Grand Tutor, one of the Three Dukes, by imperial decree!

text.content:
Silence fell over the surroundings.

Crown Prince's Grand Tutor? One of the Three Dukes? Sending a servant disciple—a废物 universally acknowledged by the entire sect—to teach the crown prince of Great Yan Empire?

Even Han Lie, who had long-standing grievances with Chen Ji, widened his eyes, his face filled with disbelief. Meanwhile, Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with an indecipherable gleam.

Only Chen Ji kept his head lowered, shoulders trembling slightly, as if terrified by this sudden imperial favor.

dialogue.content: (Purple-robed envoy, walking slowly toward Chen Ji) Grand Tutor Chen, congratulations. What, too delighted to speak?

text.content:
He stopped three feet before Chen Ji, emitting a faint pressure. That was the aura of a Golden Core stage—enough to make an ordinary Foundation Building cultivator's legs go weak. However, Chen Ji merely raised his head, gazing at him with those seemingly murky eyes, a strand of drool trickling from the corner of his mouth.

The envoy frowned slightly, disappointment flickering in his eyes.

So this was the "suspicious individual" in imperial intelligence? With this idiotic appearance, even the imperial kitchen's cooks seemed sharper.

dialogue.content: (Stammering) Yo-Your Excellency, th-this humble one... this humble one dares not accept! This humble one is merely a floor sweeper, how could I possibly teach the Crown Prince? Th-This must be a mistake!

choice.prompt: The envoy's expression was half-smiling as he watched Chen Ji's performance, his试探之心 growing rather than diminishing. Chen Ji needed to make a choice:

choices.text: Continue pretending to be an idiot
choices.description: Maintain the废物 persona, letting the envoy completely relax his guard. The more incompetent the performance, the more humiliating their reversal will be when the time comes.
choices.visible_reward: The envoy will completely underestimate your strength, leaving greater room for future action
choices.risk_hint: If the acting is exposed, you will be thoroughly exposed
choices.process_label: 你决定用最卑微的姿态迎接这突如其来的"恩典"

text.content:
Chen Ji's legs went weak, and he actually dropped to his knees on the ground, kowtowing repeatedly, the sound of his forehead striking the blue stone floor crisp and jarring. He kept muttering "dare not accept," "wrongly accused," and similar phrases, looking utterly wretched.

Snickering erupted around him. Han Lie sneered: "I knew he was a废物!" Ling Yuan's face was expressionless, only a hint of doubt flickering in his eyes—Was this performance... a bit too much?

dialogue.content: (Purple-robed envoy, greatly disappointed) Fine, fine, get up. The imperial decree has been issued—how could it be refused with a mere objection? However... (lowering his voice) This official is quite curious—how does a floor sweeper get personally named by His Majesty?

choices.text: Reveal a hint of your edge at the right moment
choices.description: Let them know you're not truly a废物, but not enough to warrant genuine vigilance. Strategic displays of strength are often safer than showing weakness.
choices.visible_reward: Will make Ling Yuan and others realize your background forces are not simple
choices.risk_hint: If the calibration is wrong, it may backfire
choices.process_label: 你决定在惶恐中夹杂一丝不易察觉的镇定

text.content:
Just as the crowd burst into laughter, Chen Ji's kowtowing motion suddenly paused for an instant. Those murky eyes lifted, meeting the envoy's gaze for less than half a breath.

The purple-robed envoy's pupils contracted sharply.

That gaze was too calm—too calm for a floor-sweeping servant. Yet just as he wanted to investigate further, Chen Ji returned to his idiotic expression, as if everything just now was merely an illusion.

dialogue.content: (Envoy, with a微妙 tone) Interesting... It seems the imperial intelligence wasn't entirely lying. Grand Tutor Chen, this official will host a banquet in the imperial capital to welcome you—hopefully, we can have a proper chat then.

choices.text: Proactively show weakness and seek shelter
choices.description: Show weakness to sect elders like Ling Yuan, seeking help to divert the envoy's attention, letting enemies underestimate the relationship between you and the sect.
choices.visible_cost: May damage your status within the sect
choices.visible_reward: Will make the envoy misjudge your situation, lowering their guard
choices.risk_hint: May be exploited by Ling Yuan
choices.process_label: 你决定向宗门长老们投去求助的目光

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly turned and actually flung himself toward Ling Yuan, wailing: "Sect Master, save me! Sect Master, this humble one doesn't want to go to the palace! This humble one only wants to sweep floors in the sect for a lifetime!"

Ling Yuan's lips twitched.

Was this废物 truly acting, or was he warning him of something?

The envoy watched this scene with great interest, his eyes glinting. Sect internal strife, imperial chess game—perhaps this piece was more complex than he imagined.

The purple-robed envoy waved his hand, and two golden-armored warriors behind him immediately stepped forward, "supporting" Chen Ji's arms from both sides. Called assistance, but actually detention.

"Grand Tutor Chen must be exhausted from the journey. Please rest at the courier station first." The envoy's voice sounded very polite, "In three days, this official will personally escort you to the capital to meet His Majesty.届时, His Highness the Crown Prince... is also very eager to meet his new Grand Tutor."

He specifically stressed the words "His Highness the Crown Prince," as if to remind him of something.

dialogue.content:
(Low voice, nearly whispering) His Highness the Crown Prince...

(To others it sounded like confusion, but if someone could see his eyes, they would find a calculating gleam deep within those pupils)

choice.prompt: The envoy seemed to want to say something more, but at this moment he paused. His gaze fell on the position of Chen Ji's chest, where a faint异样 light was visible—

choices.description: Let the envoy clearly see what it is, dispelling his doubts with a "reasonable" explanation. Sometimes a card played in the open is better than a hidden one.
choices.visible_cost: Exposes clues to your imperial background
choices.visible_reward: The envoy's assessment of you will become more complex, daring not to act hastily
choices.risk_hint: May attract more forces to covet you
choices.process_label: 你若无其事地整理衣领，让印记完全暴露

text.content:
Chen Ji calmly unbuttoned the top button of his collar.

That mark was clearly visible to everyone—the Nine-Dragon Emblem of the imperial family, only possessed by those officially recognized by the royal family. Below the mark, there was also a line of extremely small seal script.

The purple-robed envoy's expression instantly changed.

"This... this is..."

He clearly recognized the origin of this mark. It was a symbol of status sufficient to stand as his equal, or even higher. The earlier arrogance vanished in an instant.

dialogue.content: (Envoy, attitude completely changed) So that's how it is... Grand Tutor Chen truly conceals his depth. This subordinate had eyes but failed to recognize Mount Tai, I beg the Grand Tutor's forgiveness!

choices.text: Block the mark with your body
choices.description: Act as if not wanting others to see it, covering it up with "shameful past" as the excuse. The more mysterious something is, the more it arouses people's vigilance.
choices.visible_cost: The envoy's curiosity will only grow heavier
choices.visible_reward: Will leave the envoy guessing, daring not to act rashly
choices.process_label: 你迅速用手捂住胸口，故作慌张

text.content:
Chen Ji's reaction was so fast he himself hadn't anticipated it.

He abruptly turned sideways, tightly covering his chest with his other hand, mumbling: "N-Nothing... it's just a scar from being scalded as a child, didn't want to frighten the distinguished officials..."

The envoy's eyes narrowed.

A scalded scar? That light was clearly a spiritual fluctuation. This废物 is lying—but why would he lie? What is he hiding?

dialogue.content:
(Envoy, thoughtfully) A scar? Grand Tutor Chen needn't be concerned. This official has seen much of the world and won't be frightened by a mere scar.

(Reaching out, making a gesture to examine) Why not let this official give the Grand Tutor a brief examination?

choices.text: Have the Tianji Record fragment flicker briefly
choices.description: Use the faint glow from the fragment in your sleeve to interfere, causing the envoy's investigation to be slightly disrupted, thereby creating the illusion that the "mark is indeed just a scar."
choices.visible_cost: The Tianji Record fragment will have a brief exposure risk
choices.visible_reward: The envoy will be misled, thinking it's merely ordinary spiritual fluctuation
choices.risk_hint: If the fragment's aura leaks, it may attract higher-level attention
choices.process_label: 你悄然将天机录碎片贴近印记位置

text.content:
Just as the envoy reached out his hand, the jade fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve grew slightly warm.

An intangible spiritual energy fluctuation resonated with the mark—in the eyes of outsiders, it appeared as if a normal cultivator's internal spiritual power was fluctuating—no abnormality whatsoever.

The envoy frowned, his fingers hovering mid-air, hesitating for a moment before ultimately retracting.

"Enough, then." He said coolly, "Since Grand Tutor Chen is unwilling to speak, this official won't force the issue. However..."

His gaze turned meaningful: "The Empire's eyes are everywhere. The Grand Tutor should understand this principle."

The envoy turned and boarded the dragon carriage. Before departing, he glanced back at Chen Ji once more.

That gaze carried three parts wariness, three parts curiosity, and four parts of something indefinable.

"Three days later, at the courier station."

Golden rays erupted skyward once more, nine dragon carriages slowly rising into the air, gradually vanishing into the depths of the clouds.

The surrounding sect disciples finally dared to speak, discussion erupting. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing toward where the convoy had disappeared, his face still wearing that ignorant, unknowing expression.

Only he knew that in that instant just now, he had consumed five points of Heavenly Fate.

dialogue.content: (Inside the Tianji Record Fragment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice echoed幽幽) Five points of Heavenly Fate, exchanged for a temporary retreat by a Golden Core cultivator... Was this a fair trade?

(Cold smile in his heart) Fair or not depends on how much time those five points of Heavenly Fate can buy me.

Empire, sect, Eyes of Heaven... three major forces have set their sights on me simultaneously. I need time to strategize, time to find Nian, time to make the Tianji Record more complete.

(His gaze gradually turned cold) So let them continue treating me as a废物.

choice.prompt: Just as Chen Ji turned to leave, he suddenly felt a sharp pain in his chest—that imperial mark had activated on its own again, emitting an eerie fluctuation that did not belong to the mortal world.

choices.text: Endure the discomfort and leave immediately
choices.description: Cannot expose abnormality before so many eyes—must return to his quarters to check the mark's condition. Private investigation is safer than public confrontation.
choices.visible_cost: If the mark problem is serious, may miss the best timing for treatment
choices.risk_hint: The mark's abnormality may spiral out of control
choices.process_label: 你咬紧牙关，掩饰住痛苦，转身向住处走去

text.content:
Chen Ji's pace remained steady, his expression still wooden.

However, in that instant he turned around, his hand subtly pressed against his chest. The burning sensation there was intensifying, as if an invisible hand was touching his soul through that mark.

This sensation... he had never encountered it in the Tianji Record.

In other words, something had deliberately avoided the Tianji Record's探查.

choices.text: Stop and circulate spiritual energy to suppress it
choices.description: Publicly perform the illusion of "going into qi deviation during cultivation," while secretly suppressing the mark's abnormality. Let no one know this mark has a problem.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger commotion, attracting more attention
choices.visible_reward: Rationalize the abnormality, not arousing deep suspicion
choices.risk_hint: If suppression fails, will be humiliated on the spot
choices.process_label: 你突然停下，单手结印，做出运功调息的姿态

text.content:
"What's wrong with Senior Chen?"
"Is he too excited? After all, he suddenly became Crown Prince's Grand Tutor..."
"Tch, I knew he just stumbled into狗屎运."

The surrounding chatter entered his ears, unheeded by Chen Ji. His spiritual energy wound around that mark like spider silk, attempting to suppress its abnormality.

Yet that mark seemed to possess its own consciousness—upon contact with his spiritual energy, it actually trembled slightly—resembling some kind of response, or some kind of warning.

choices.text: Secretly activate the Tianji Record fragment to investigate
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's incomplete foresight ability to examine the truth behind this mark's abnormality. High risk, high reward—may obtain crucial information, or may consume more Heavenly Fate points.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate points will be consumed again, and may expose the Tianji Record's existence
choices.visible_reward: Gain foreknowledge of the mark's truth ahead of time, preparing for the next step
choices.risk_hint: If the information volume is too large, may damage divine consciousness
choices.process_label: 你的手指在袖中悄然触碰天机录碎片

text.content:
The Tianji Record fragment grew slightly warm in his sleeve as Chen Ji's consciousness sank into it.

He intended to foresee what would happen with this mark in the next three hours—yet just as he focused his attention—

Chaos.

Not "unable to see clearly," but "does not exist." As if something had forcibly carved this small block of time out from what he could foresee.

And within this chaos, a pair of eyes slowly opened.

That gaze held no emotion, no temperature, yet it seemed capable of penetrating time and space, gazing directly into the depths of his soul.

dialogue.content:
(Eyes of Heaven, silent whisper echoing in Chen Ji's mind) Found you...

The next instant, Chen Ji snapped back to reality.

The mark's abnormality ceased; the surrounding cacophony re-entered his ears. As if nothing had happened.

Yet he knew—something had already changed.

text.content:
Night fell, courier station.

Chen Ji sat alone by the window, moonlight filtering through the window lattice to fall upon the fragmented jade piece in his palm. Faint patterns emerged on the jade's surface—that was the Tianji Record's seal slowly unraveling.

Everything that happened today had fallen outside his calculations.

The imperial envoy, that suddenly activating mark, and those eyes watching him within the chaos...

He took a deep breath, storing the jade piece in his chest.

Whatever that was, there was no turning back. The piece has entered the game—once a chess piece is placed, there are no regrets.

Outside the window, the night was deep as ink. In the distance, the lights of the imperial capital spread like a starry sea, and in the higher heavens—in the void depths even Nascent Soul True Persons supposedly cannot reach—something was slowly awakening.
